question: Among 1290 individuals of a population under study, the numbers of individuals with blood group types M, MN, and N are, respectively, 340, 880, and 70
source: IBO 2018 理论考试 2（Theoretical Exam 2）第 7 题

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on the data, the frequencies of M and N alleles in the population are, respectively, 0.7 and 0.3

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The population describe above is in Hardy Weinberg equilibrium with respect to alleles of the MN blood group

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: If there is random mating in a population in which frequency of M alleles is 0.6 and frequency of N alleles is 0.4, the frequency of offspring with the NN genotype will be 0.16

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: In a start generation with frequency of M = 0.6 and frequency of N = 0.4, after three generations of random mating the frequency of MM individuals in the population of the fourth generation who are offspring of MN*MN matings will be <10%

subject: 细胞生物学
